design.quote: The study was set-up as a placebo controlled, within subject, phase 1 trial as it was the first to administer 4-FA to humans under controlled conditions.
design.text: A placebo-controlled, within-subject, phase 1 trial evaluating 4-FA in healthy volunteers.

findings.quote: In summary, single dose administrations of 4-FA produced significant cardiovascular complications. The drug produced strong elevations in blood pressure during 4 h after administration that were followed by a sustained increase in heart rate.
findings.text: Single doses of 4-FA in healthy volunteers caused significant cardiovascular complications, including strong elevations in blood pressure for 4 hours followed by a sustained increase in heart rate.

findings.quote: Effects of 4-FA on mood and neurocognitive function were most distinct at 1 h post drug and included significant elevations of vigor, friendliness, elation, arousal, positive mood, as well as improvements in attention and motor performance.
findings.text: In healthy volunteers, 4-FA produced significant elevations in vigor, friendliness, elation, arousal, and positive mood, along with improvements in attention and motor performance at 1 hour post drug.

findings.quote: They may be at an increased risk for cardiotoxicity because subjective feelings of high already dissipate when serum levels of 4-FA and heart rate are still elevated or on the rise.
findings.text: People who use 4-FA may be at an increased risk for cardiotoxicity because the subjective high dissipates while serum levels and heart rate remain elevated or are rising.
